itens.titulo: Turkish foreign minister, intelligence chief meet Libyan premier in Istanbul
itens.resumo: No further details of meeting were made immediately available

itens.titulo: Bahrain renews threat alert amid Iranian attacks

itens.titulo: Türkiye promoted climate vision through public diplomacy at COP31: Communications chief
itens.resumo: Türkiye contributed to global climate awareness through strategic communication, panels and meetings during Antalya summit, says Burhanettin Duran
itens.titulo_pt: Türkiye promoveu a visão climática através da diplomacia pública na COP31: Chefe das Comunicações
itens.resumo_pt: Türkiye contribuiu para a conscientização global do clima através de comunicação estratégica, painéis e reuniões durante a cúpula de Antalya.

itens.titulo: Israel’s Eisenkot invites Netanyahu’s Likud party to new coalition talks: Report
itens.resumo: Yashar proposes Sunday meeting as Likud reportedly urges Eisenkot to rule out minority government backed by Arab parties

itens.resumo_pt: Yashar propõe uma reunião de domingo, como Likud supostamente insta Eisenkot a descartar o governo minoritário apoiado por partidos árabes.

itens.titulo: Bahrain says Iranian attack sets ‘civilian’ industrial site ablaze

itens.titulo: London protest calls for stricter AI regulation amid growing safety concerns

itens.titulo: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted another Houthi drone headed toward Riyadh region

itens.titulo: Israel’s Lieberman says ousting Netanyahu remains his ‘main goal’

itens.titulo: Pakistani minister proposes SCO-wide framework to address damage to historical sites at India summit

itens.titulo: Galatasaray beat Samsunspor, Fenerbahce held to draw by Kocaelispor in Turkish Super Lig
